## Task Link
WPS-7979

## Summary
Fixes a client-side price manipulation vulnerability in the global calendar booking add-to-cart flow. Previously, `booking_price` was passed as a URL parameter and trusted directly in the cart, allowing any user to set an arbitrary price. Price is now always derived server-side from calendar meta.

## Claude Usage
- Used: Yes
- Purpose: Diff review, commit message authoring, SOP doc completion
- Output generated: Commit `de8d431`; SOP docs filled
- What was manually verified/modified: All PHP/JS fix code written manually; Claude reviewed and committed

## Changes Made
- `common/…-common.php`: Added server-side price resolver, cart price enforcement hook, and direct add-to-cart block; removed trusted `booking_price` from totals hook
- `includes/…-woocommerce.php`: Registered two new hooks; renamed handler to `mwb_handle_global_booking_add_to_cart`
- `public/…-public.php`: Renamed method; replaced client price calc with server-side resolver; removed `booking_price` from cart item data; hard-reject on invalid booking
- `public/js/mwb-global-booking-shortcode.js`: Removed `booking_price` from redirect URL

## Testing
- Tested locally: Yes
- Edge cases covered: Invalid calendar ID, malformed dates, draft calendar, direct URL price manipulation, direct add-to-cart bypass
